title: NPC Continuity, Relationship & Callback Binding
objective: Provide stable NPC narrative identity, callback conditions, re-encounter references and relationship/timeline hooks so earlier interactions can matter later without duplicating Relationship, Reputation or NPC canonical state inside the content pack.

scope.purpose: Provide stable NPC narrative continuity and callback binding without duplicating owner-domain state.
scope.completion_gate: Earlier NPC interactions can matter later through stable identity, callback, re-encounter and relationship/timeline hooks without duplicating Relationship, Reputation or NPC canonical state inside the content pack.

selection_boundaries: CNI-06 is completed_verified before CNI-07 implementation.
Relationship, Reputation, NPC and timeline owner domains retain canonical state; CNI-07 binds only declared references/projections.
CNI-03 remains scoped narrative-state authority, CNI-04 predicate/query authority and CNI-05 dialogue/action-binding authority.
Missing, ambiguous or unsupported callback evidence must fail closed rather than be inferred.
CNI-08+, PCA and SMB-08 remain unauthorized during CNI-07 implementation.
PCA remains eligible but unselected and unauthorized.

implementation_plan.red: Add a focused CNI-07 acceptance and Validation Core profile proving stable NPC narrative identity, callback/re-encounter binding, owner relationship/timeline reference preservation and fail-closed missing/ambiguous evidence before production implementation exists.
implementation_plan.green: Implement the minimum deterministic NPC continuity/callback adapter over declared owner references and existing CNI predicate/dialogue seams without adding NPC, Relationship, Reputation or timeline canonical state.
implementation_plan.proof: Add CNI-07 compliance evidence, governance boundary documentation and source-governance verifier; then exact-head Linux/Windows profile validation, client typecheck and deterministic cross-platform comparison.
implementation_plan.closeout: Merge only the exact validated application head, verify validated tree equals merge tree, then OPS3-close CNI-07 and select only the roadmap-permitted successor.

next_action: CNI-07 is completed_verified; CNI-08 is the selected_not_started successor and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
